hero.title: Christmas Day Lunch
hero.lede: Let someone else do the cooking on 25 December. Family tables in our restaurant and conservatory, a festive menu from our kitchen, and nothing to wash up.

sections.title: Christmas Day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Christmas Day is for being with the people you love, not for peeling potatoes at seven in the morning. On 25 December we open the restaurant and the conservatory for lunch, lay the tables for families large and small, and cook a festive menu in our own kitchen, so all you have to do is turn up.

Each party has its own table, whether that is two of you or three generations, and the conservatory, with daylight through the glass, suits a long, unhurried lunch. Children are welcome and we can serve smaller portions. The menu keeps to what Christmas lunch should be, with a traditional main course and the alternatives people ask for, and is confirmed each autumn along with the price and the sitting times. Tell us about allergies and dietary needs when you book.

Christmas Day lunch books up well ahead, so get in touch early. If family are travelling to join you, our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs: a cooked breakfast on Christmas morning, then a short walk downstairs to lunch. See our festive stays for rooms over the holidays.

sections.title: The rooms, the food and the morning after

items.title: The restaurant and conservatory
items.text: Family tables in our restaurant and in the purpose-built glass conservatory alongside it. Tell us which you’d prefer and we’ll do our best.

items.title: A festive menu from our kitchen
items.text: A traditional Christmas main course with alternatives, smaller portions for children, and dietary needs catered for when you tell us ahead. Confirmed each autumn.

items.title: Stay over Christmas
items.text: Our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs. Wake on Christmas morning to breakfast cooked to order, then come down to lunch.

sections.title: Christmas Day lunch: what people ask us

items.q: How far ahead should we book Christmas Day lunch?
items.a: As early as you can. Tables go quickly once the menu and price are confirmed each autumn. Call 01698 265588 or send an enquiry and we’ll let you know as soon as bookings open.
We usually ask for a deposit to hold a Christmas Day table. We’ll explain how much, when it is due and our cancellation terms when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for allergies, and for vegetarian or vegan guests?
items.a: Yes. Tell us when you book about allergies, intolerances and anyone who is vegetarian or vegan, and how many children are coming so we can plan smaller portions.

items.q: Is there parking on Christmas Day, and do trains run?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free. Train services are very limited on Christmas Day, so most guests come by car or stay with us the night before. Motherwell is just off the M74 at junction 6.

sections.title: Book your table for Christmas Day
sections.text: Tell us your numbers and we’ll be in touch as soon as this year’s menu is confirmed.
